title: tp4u
description:
Provide the 'tp' command for non-administrator users of the server, which can be used in conjunction with the minimap. It is designed to be lightweight, simple, and easy to understand.

为服务器的非管理员提供tp指令，可联合小地图使用，设计轻量化，简单易懂
body:
Tp4u Teleportation Module Command Set
All commands start with /tp4u. Ordinary players can use them without administrator permissions. 

1. Request to be teleported to another player's location
Command: /tp4u to <Player Name>
Example: /tp4u to Steve
Description: Send a request to the specified player, hoping to be teleported to their location. Once they agree, you will instantly move to their position. 

2. Request other players to teleport to your location
Command: /tp4u playertohere <player name>
Example: /tp4u playertohere Alex
Explanation: Send a request to the specified player, hoping that he will teleport to your location. Once the other party agrees, he will instantly appear at your position. 

3. Accept Teleport Request
Command: /tp4u accept
Description: When you receive a teleport request, enter this command to agree. The system will automatically determine the teleport direction based on the request type (who teleports to whom). 

4. Deny Teleport Request
Command: /tp4u deny
Description: Reject the current teleport request you have received. The other party will receive a prompt saying "Rejected". 

5. Teleport directly to coordinates
Command: /tp4u to <x> <y> <z>
Example: /tp4u to 123.45 64 789.12
Description: Teleport directly to the specified three-dimensional coordinates (supports decimals and can be used in conjunction with the minimap mod). No need to wait for others' consent. 

* tips:

Request timeout: Each request is only valid for 30 seconds. If it times out, it will automatically become invalid, and the requester will receive a prompt saying "Request has timed out".
Only one pending request at a time: If you send a request to someone and then send a new request (regardless of the recipient), the previous request will be overwritten.
You cannot send a request to yourself: The system will prompt "You cannot send a transfer request to yourself".
Cross-dimensional transfer is supported: All transfers support cross-dimensions (such as the Nether and the End). 

If you have any questions, please contact the administrator. Have a great time playing the game!



Tp4u 传送模组指令集
所有指令均以 /tp4u 开头，普通玩家无需管理员权限即可使用。

1.请求传送到其他玩家身边
指令： /tp4u to <玩家名>
示例： /tp4u to Steve
说明： 向指定玩家发送请求，希望你传送到他身边。对方同意后你会瞬间移动到他的位置。

2.请求其他玩家传送到自己身边
指令： /tp4u playertohere <玩家名>
示例： /tp4u playertohere Alex
说明： 向指定玩家发送请求，希望他传送到你身边。对方同意后他会瞬间来到你的位置。

3.接受传送请求
指令： /tp4u accept
说明： 当你收到传送请求时，输入此命令即可同意对方。系统会根据请求类型自动判断传送方向（谁传送到谁身边）。

4.拒绝传送请求
指令： /tp4u deny
说明： 拒绝当前收到的传送请求，对方会收到“已拒绝”的提示。

5.直接传送到坐标
指令： /tp4u to <x> <y> <z>
示例： /tp4u to 123.45 64 789.12
说明： 直接传送到指定的三维坐标（支持小数，可结合小地图模组使用）。无需等待他人同意。

*提示

请求超时：每个请求只有 30秒 有效期，超时后自动失效，请求方会收到“请求已超时”的提示。
同一时间只能有一个待处理请求：如果你向某人发送请求后又发送新请求（无论给谁），前一个请求会被覆盖。
不能向自己发送请求：系统会提示“你不能向自己发送传送请求”。
可以跨维度传送：所有传送均支持跨维度（如下界、末地）。

如有任何问题，请联系管理员。祝你游戏愉快！
